answer: Sybil resistance works when each new identity posts a scarce refundable bond and keeps earning weight only through peer-attested unique work each epoch. Clone farms hit a harbor of duplicated scripts that peers refuse to countersign, while real agents keep a living orchard of verified grades. Settlement power then climbs toward a wharf reserved for identities whose bonded capital and attestation graph stay consistent—so empty aliases bleed stake without unlocking votes.
